note: Every default the deal model uses, with where it came from. 'confidence' is high (read in the law or an official publication), medium (good secondary source, or official text plus an interpretation), low (commercial sources only, or an assumption). To change a value for good, put it under "overrides" in the data folder's profile.json rather than editing this file. Full research notes with quotes and links: <data folder>/research/.

assumptions.label: Dirhams per £1
assumptions.source: Bank Al-Maghrib reference rate, 17 Nov 2026. Five-year range about 11.7–13.2: sterling is near its high, so the same flat costs fewer pounds than usual, and future rent converts back to fewer pounds if that persists. REFRESH before each analysis.

assumptions.label: Dirhams per €1
assumptions.source: Bank Al-Maghrib reference rate, 17 Nov 2026. The dirham is pegged to a 60% euro / 40% dollar basket within ±5%.

assumptions.label: Dirhams per $1
assumptions.source: Bank Al-Maghrib reference rate, 17 Nov 2026.

assumptions.label: Dirhams per 1 unit of your home currency (used throughout)
assumptions.source: Picked from the rows above by home_currency in profile.json.

assumptions.label: Cost of converting and wiring money to Morocco
assumptions.source: Assumption: about 0.5–1% with a currency broker, 2–3% through a high-street bank. Get a quote.

assumptions.label: Your marginal income-tax rate at home
assumptions.source: UK higher rate, used as a cautious default — set your own in profile.json (UK: 20% / 40% / 45%; announced to become 22% / 42% / 47% for property income from April 2027). A UK resident is taxed on worldwide rental profit, with credit for Moroccan income tax (UK–Morocco treaty arts 6 and 22). Set 0 if you are tax-resident in Morocco.

assumptions.label: Your capital-gains tax rate at home
assumptions.source: UK higher rate on residential property gains 2026-27 (18% within the basic-rate band); Moroccan tax on the gain is credited. The UK computes the gain in sterling, so exchange-rate moves change it. Set 0 if not applicable.

assumptions.label: Tax relief at home on mortgage interest
assumptions.source: UK: interest and finance costs on a let home are not deducted from the profit; instead 20% of them comes off the tax bill (ITTOIA 2005 s.274A, HMRC PIM2054), for lets abroad as well as in the UK, capped at the profit. Only matters to a buyer with a mortgage. Set to your marginal rate if interest is fully deductible where you live, or 0 if there is no relief.

assumptions.label: Registration duty (droits d'enregistrement)
assumptions.source: Code Général des Impôts 2026, art. 133-I-F-1°: 4% on built property, same for Moroccans and foreigners. (Bare land 5%.) Since 1 July 2026 an EXTRA 2% applies to any part of the price not paid by traceable bank means (art. 133-III) — pay everything by transfer through the notary.

assumptions.label: Land registry (conservation foncière)
assumptions.source: ANCFCC tariff, Decree 2-16-375: 1.5% of the price.

assumptions.label: Land registry fixed fee (MAD)
assumptions.source: ANCFCC tariff: 100 MAD per property.

assumptions.label: Notary's fee, before VAT
assumptions.source: About 1% is custom and negotiable — no published fee decree was found (a Casablanca notary, 2025: 'grosso modo, c'est 1%'). Ask for a written, itemised quote.

assumptions.label: Notary's minimum fee (MAD)
assumptions.source: Assumption. Blogs quote minimums of 1,500–4,000 MAD; not verified.

assumptions.label: VAT on the notary's fee
assumptions.source: 20% since 1 Jan 2023 (CGI art. 99; Loi de Finances 2023). Many online simulators still use the old 10%.

assumptions.label: Certificates, stamps, preliminary-contract duty, copies (MAD)
assumptions.source: 2 ownership certificates at 100 MAD, 200 MAD duty on the preliminary contract (CGI art. 135-II-17°), ~1,500 MAD stamps and copies (estimate).

assumptions.label: Estate agent's commission charged to the buyer
assumptions.source: Agents are unregulated; commission is whatever is agreed. Commonly quoted: 2.5% including VAT, sometimes from each side. The video: 2–3.5%, aim for 2, never above 3. Agree it in writing before viewing; 0 if buying direct from the owner.

assumptions.label: VAT added on top of the agent's commission
assumptions.source: 0 because commissions are usually quoted including VAT ('TTC'). Set 0.20 if yours is quoted before VAT ('HT').

assumptions.label: Share of the price a bank lends — foreign non-resident
assumptions.source: Exchange-control ceiling is 80% since 1 Jan 2026 (Office des Changes, IGOC 2026 — it was 70% when the video was made), but banks publish less for foreigners: Bank of Africa 50%, CIH 70% (15 years max), Banque Populaire 70%. A foreigner must also declare they own no other home in Morocco.

assumptions.label: Share of the price a bank lends — Moroccan living abroad (MRE)
assumptions.source: Legal ceiling 80% (IGOC 2026); the balance must arrive in foreign currency. Bank practice 70–80%.

assumptions.label: Share of the price a bank lends — Moroccan resident
assumptions.source: Banks advertise up to 90–100% for residents; 80% is a prudent planning figure.

assumptions.label: Loan-to-value used (from the buyer type at the top)
assumptions.source: Picked by buyer type.

assumptions.label: Fixed rate before VAT — foreign non-resident
assumptions.source: Official average for new housing loans was 4.53% in Q2 2026 (Bank Al-Maghrib); 5.0% adds a prudence margin for a non-resident (the size of any non-resident premium is unverified). The video's 4.3% was a best-profile rate. Rates are negotiable; get three offers.

assumptions.label: Fixed rate before VAT — MRE
assumptions.source: Crédit du Maroc's advertised MRE rate (4.71% excl. VAT, Nov 2026).

assumptions.label: Fixed rate before VAT — Moroccan resident
assumptions.source: Bank Al-Maghrib average for new housing loans, Q2 2026: 4.53%.

assumptions.label: Rate before VAT used (from the buyer type)
assumptions.source: Picked by buyer type.

assumptions.label: VAT on mortgage interest
assumptions.source: Moroccan mortgage rates are quoted before a 10% VAT on the interest (CGI arts 89 and 99). The video's figures ignore it.

assumptions.label: Rate actually paid, including VAT on interest
assumptions.source: Rate × (1 + VAT). This is what the repayment is calculated on.

assumptions.label: Loan term (years)
assumptions.source: 25 years is the usual maximum; CIH caps non-resident foreigners at 15. Banks generally want the loan repaid by age 70. Average new loan: 21 years (Bank Al-Maghrib, 2025).

assumptions.label: Compulsory life/disability insurance, % of the loan per year
assumptions.source: Market average 0.40% a year (Afdal mortgage barometer, Feb 2026). Applied here to the original loan, which slightly overstates it.

assumptions.label: Mortgage registration — rate on the first slice
assumptions.source: ANCFCC tariff: 0.5% up to 250,000 MAD.

assumptions.label: Mortgage registration — size of the first slice (MAD)
assumptions.source: ANCFCC tariff.

assumptions.label: Mortgage registration — rate above the first slice
assumptions.source: ANCFCC tariff: 1.5% from 250,001 to 5,000,000 MAD. Applied by slice (a notary's worked example); some offices may charge 1.5% on the whole loan.

assumptions.label: Mortgage deed duty, fixed fee, stamps (MAD)
assumptions.source: 100 MAD registry fee + 200 MAD duty on the mortgage deed + ~300 MAD stamps.

assumptions.label: Bank file fee, % of the loan
assumptions.source: Reported regulatory cap of 0.1% of the loan (2015 order under Law 31-08).

assumptions.label: How far sold prices sit below asking prices
assumptions.source: ASSUMPTION — no published figure exists for Morocco. Adverts are asking prices; in 2026 sales volumes fell sharply while asking prices held, which favours buyers. Replace with what agents tell you flats actually SOLD for (area_price_per_m2 in the property record).

assumptions.label: Opening offer, % below your target price
assumptions.source: Negotiating convention, not data.

assumptions.label: Airbnb / Booking fee, % of bookings
assumptions.source: Airbnb's single host-only fee is 15.5% and became standard through 2026 (the old 3% host fee is gone for most hosts). Booking.com charges about 15%. The video deducts nothing.

assumptions.label: Management company (conciergerie), % of bookings
assumptions.source: Quoted rates: 20–30% of gross in Marrakech, 20% from one Rabat firm (commercial sources, 2026). The video's 10% is not a market rate for full service. Ask exactly what is included (cleaning, linen, check-in).

assumptions.label: Upkeep, linen and supplies, % of bookings
assumptions.source: AirROI's cost model for a Moroccan listing: upkeep 3% + supplies 2% of bookings (Nov 2026).

assumptions.label: Building service charge if not stated (MAD per m² per month)
assumptions.source: Thin evidence: typical 400–1,200 MAD a month; 1,250–2,100 with pool and security; one Rabat Hay Riad example ≈ 11 MAD/m². Always ask for the syndic's latest statement.

assumptions.label: Electricity + water (MAD per month)
assumptions.source: Assumption in line with the video's ~€60 for electricity. Air-conditioning in summer pushes this up.

assumptions.label: Fibre internet (MAD per month)
assumptions.source: Assumption in line with the video's ~€35.

assumptions.label: TV / streaming subscriptions (MAD per month)
assumptions.source: The video's ~€21.

assumptions.label: Home insurance (MAD per year)
assumptions.source: Assumption. Get a quote that covers paying guests.

assumptions.label: Housing tax if you also use the flat yourself, % of price per year
assumptions.source: 0 for a flat let all year. If you keep it as a second home, taxe d'habitation applies with no abatement: roughly 0.6–1.2% of price a year with the communal tax (Law 47-06, arts 19–36); about 0.2% for an MRE's main Moroccan home.

assumptions.label: Moroccan local taxes on a short let, % of bookings
assumptions.source: ESTIMATE, range 5–10%. Communal services tax is 10.5% of rents by the letter of the law (Law 47-06 art. 35-b), or of a lower assessed rental value in practice; if the let is treated as a business, a 10% business tax on rental value follows after a five-year exemption.

assumptions.label: Moroccan income tax on short-let income, % of bookings
assumptions.source: CENTRAL ESTIMATE, range 2.5–15%. The law is unsettled: many hosts declare as ordinary rental income (40% allowance, then the progressive scale — about 8% of bookings at 180,000 MAD a year), but the tax office's written doctrine treats furnished letting as a business. Together with local taxes: about 15% of bookings, range 8–25%, plus VAT risk above 500,000 MAD turnover. The video includes no tax at all. Confirm with a Moroccan tax adviser.

assumptions.label: Vacancy (share of the year empty)
assumptions.source: Assumption: one month a year.

assumptions.label: Letting agent / management, % of rent
assumptions.source: Assumption.

assumptions.label: Maintenance, % of rent
assumptions.source: Assumption.

assumptions.label: Owner pays the syndic? (1 = yes, 0 = tenant)
assumptions.source: Depends on the lease; 1 is the cautious choice.

assumptions.label: Owner bears the communal tax? (1 = yes, 0 = recharged to tenant)
assumptions.source: Legally the owner's (Law 47-06 art. 33); a lease can recharge it.

assumptions.label: Communal services tax (TSC), % of annual rent
assumptions.source: Law 47-06 arts 35-b and 36: 10.5% of rents in urban areas (6.5% in outlying zones).

assumptions.label: Flat allowance on rental income
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 64-II: tax is charged on 60% of gross rent. The old flat 10% / 15% regime ended on 31 Dec 2022 — several big-firm summaries still describe it.

assumptions.label: Tax-free up to (MAD)
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I. The 2027 finance bill proposes 60,000 — check once the Loi de Finances 2027 is published (January).

assumptions.label: 10% band ends at (MAD)
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I.

assumptions.label: 20% band ends at (MAD)
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I.

assumptions.label: 30% band ends at (MAD)
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I.

assumptions.label: 34% band ends at (MAD)
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I.

assumptions.label: Rate, band 1
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I.

assumptions.label: Rate, band 2
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I.

assumptions.label: Rate, band 3
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I.

assumptions.label: Rate, band 4
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I.

assumptions.label: Top rate
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-I. Check: 96,000 taxable gives 10,800, matching the tax office's own 2026 example.

assumptions.label: Occupancy falls by (percentage points)
assumptions.source: Chosen to be uncomfortable but plausible: listings are growing faster than visitors in most Moroccan cities.

assumptions.label: Nightly rate falls by
assumptions.source: As above.

assumptions.label: Mortgage rate comes in higher by (percentage points)
assumptions.source: Covers a worse offer than assumed. A fixed-rate loan does not move after signing; 97% of new Moroccan mortgages are fixed.

assumptions.label: Price growth per year — flat-ish
assumptions.source: What actually happened: the official residential price index (Bank Al-Maghrib / ANCFCC, via BIS) rose about 2.5% IN TOTAL from 2010 to mid-2026, and fell about 22% after inflation.

assumptions.label: Price growth per year — middle
assumptions.source: Assumption: prices merely keep pace with inflation — already better than the last 16 years.

assumptions.label: Price growth per year — optimistic
assumptions.source: Assumption. The video's 'worth a million in 30–40 years' needs about 6–7% a year for decades; nothing in the record supports modelling that.

assumptions.label: Selling costs (agent), % of sale price
assumptions.source: Same basis as the buying commission.

assumptions.label: Moroccan tax on the gain
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 73-II-F-6°: 20% of the net gain.

assumptions.label: Minimum Moroccan tax, % of sale price
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 144-II: at least 3% of the sale price even with no gain. The main-home exemption (5 years) is lost once a flat has been let (art. 63-II-B).

assumptions.label: Flat allowance for buying costs in the gain calculation
assumptions.source: CGI 2026 art. 65-II: 15% of the purchase price unless actual costs are higher. Inflation indexation of the cost is ignored here (cautious).

assumptions.group: The video's own assumptions (used only in the ★ section)
assumptions.label: Occupancy the video assumes
assumptions.source: Video 1:23:31: 'average occupancy rate in Marrakech is 70%' = 21 nights a month, every month. Airbnb trackers put the market average near 40% (Marrakech) and 38% (Rabat); 70% is the level of classified hotels and of the top quarter of listings.

assumptions.group: The video's own assumptions (used only in the ★ section)
assumptions.label: Management fee the video uses
assumptions.source: Video 1:25:33: 'ranges from 10 to 20%… let's say 10%'. Market quotes for full service: 20–30%.

assumptions.group: The video's own assumptions (used only in the ★ section)
assumptions.label: Optional contingency the video mentions, % of revenue
assumptions.source: Video 1:26:33: 'you could add 10% contingency in case things go wrong'. He does not deduct it in his own example.
